verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Vonage Video ships official client libraries for web, mobile and desktop plus server-side SDKs. The docs also describe the client SDKs doing real work, such as transparent media-routing switches and JWT-based access, and a community user calls the platform easy to implement. missing for 10: an enumerated list of supported SDK languages/platforms, SDK reference documentation or versioning details, and independent hands-on corroboration specific to the current Vonage SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The platform includes client libraries for the web, mobile and desktop platform as well as server-side SDKs.
The switch between peer-to-peer relaying and Media Router relaying is handled transparently by the client SDKs.
Server-generated Vonage Application JWT tokens grant client SDK access.
